title: Production comedy script
script:
It looks like personal automation. It is actually a shell of a corporate infrastructure department.

They tell you it’s a personal assistant. It is a personal accounting nightmare. One message, one API call, one pound lost to your account.

The lobster? A marketing decision. The rebrand? A marketing decision. The build system? A committee’s nightmare.

It promises anything, everywhere. All it can do is ask you to read a README that was written by a different department.

It’s not an assistant. It’s a bill.
